notes.title: 5/24　update
notes.content:
-You can now jump using the space key
-The structure of the map has changed significantly.
- Implemented a dark room
- Implemented forced scrolling
-The number of enemy types has increased
-Introduced Steam achievements

notes.title: Update to avoid processing failures
notes.content:
In response to reports of processing delays occurring while playing, we have merged and deleted some stages for optimization.
Therefore, the stage configuration has changed significantly. We apologize for the inconvenience.
